model.name: flame-established v1.0
model.architecture: L2-regularised logistic regression (lambda 1) on standardised oxygen vol% and a PMMA indicator
model.target: Whether a flame was established after the ignition attempt, coded from NASA test-table comments. Not burn outcome, flame spread or fire risk.

data.origin: Legacy BASS and BASS-II rows from an earlier MicroFire prototype. In MicroFire-V2 these rows are quarantined pending cell-by-cell primary-source review; only B20 is admitted.
data.provenanceDefect: The legacy B16, B19 and B20 rows carry the uncalibrated oxygen readings (16.4 to 16.5 vol%). The calibrated columns of NASA TM-20210011385 Table A.1 read 17.3 to 17.4 vol%, and the offset varies by row (data/quarantine/b16-b19-source-review.json). Oxygen is the model's main feature.

evaluation.method: Grouped leave-one-session-out cross-validation with 95% percentile bootstrap intervals

reasons: Balanced accuracy is 0.50, the same as chance: with 4 negatives in 41 records the model effectively always predicts that a flame is established.
Its Brier-score interval overlaps the no-feature baseline, so the improvement is not established.
55 of the 56 rows it draws on are quarantined in MicroFire-V2 (data/quarantine/legacy-ledger.json); the 56th, B20, is admitted only with its corrected calibrated oxygen, which the model never saw.
Its target is ignition success inside one ISS glovebox setup; it cannot speak to lunar gravity, habitat pressure or fire safety.

reproduce.repository: MicroFire-Atlas-Final (the team’s private prototype repository; not part of this submission)
reproduce.note: Deterministic and seeded; the figures above are copied from its output on 2026-11-14. Reviewers can request a run.

wouldChangeTheDecision: Independent review admitting enough BASS-II rows with calibrated oxygen, a held-out session set fixed before training, a model beating the baseline on balanced accuracy and Brier with non-overlapping intervals, and an operating-domain gate that abstains outside the recorded conditions.
